differences: Submission: Bid1: Dallas ISD prefers responses to be submitted online via our electronic system. Manual submissions must be delivered to …; Bid2: eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) e-Procurement system.
Contract term: Bid1: Initial Term: 3 years; Renewal 1: 1 year; Renewal 2: 1 year; Total max 5 years; not stated for Bid2.
Purchasing vehicle: Bid1: Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA); Bid2: Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract, 060B5400007.

summary: Key differences: Bid1 has a later deadline ([Addendum 2 RFP JA-207652 Stud…, p. 1]: 2024-07-09) vs Bid2 ([Dell Laptops w_Extended Warra…, p. 1]: 2024-06-10); Bid1 requires online submission with manual options [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, p. 9] while Bid2 uses eMMA [PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 1]; Bid1 offers 5-year max term [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, p. 2] vs Bid2's unspecified term; Bid1 has 10-day payment terms [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, p. 51] vs Bid2's $20/3% payment rule [Dell_Laptop_Specs.pdf, p. 3]; Bid1 needs MWBE forms [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, pp. 32-34] while Bid2 requires Mercury Affidavit [PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 2]; Bid1 uses CTPA [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, p. 20] vs Bid2's 2015 Master Contract [PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 1]; Bid2 specifies Dell hardware ([PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 3]-[Dell_Laptop_Specs.pdf, p. 1]) while Bid1 lists generic monitors [JA-207652 Student and Staff C…, p. 35]. All matter for compliance and execution timing.
